start: A member's page as owner; the member has 'Share my workouts with my trainers' on in the app and has trained for 12 weeks

steps.action: Open the member and look at the Progress card
user_sees: 12 weeks of kg lifted, oldest first, this week last (weeks start Monday; a week with no workout is 0), best lifts and new records
must_not: A week missing from the chart instead of shown as 0; a week that starts on Sunday

steps.action: Look at the strength trend of an exercise
user_sees: One point per day; a tag 'Steady', 'Dropping', the rising word, or 'Not enough data yet'
must_not: A rising or dropping tag from too few workouts; a body-weight move scored in kg

steps.action: Tap the cheer on WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens to that member with ready words; the owner presses send
must_not: A message sent by itself; body weight or anything the member did not share in the words

start: My members list, signed in as a trainer with three members assigned who all share their workouts

steps.action: Open 'My members'
user_sees: Only this trainer's own members; each with one line: a help request (shown for 7 days), quiet for 7 days or more, a new best (news for 14 days), or steady
must_not: A member of another trainer; a member who has not switched sharing on

steps.action: Open one member
user_sees: The same Progress card and strength trend the owner sees
must_not: Dues, payments, complaints or feedback of the member

steps.action: Tap the cheer on WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens to that member with ready words
must_not: A message sent by itself

start: Other way in as owner: the list of all members' progress (the 'My members' list with every trainer's members)

steps.action: Open the list
user_sees: Every sharing member of the gym, with the trainer's name beside each
must_not: Members who do not share listed with empty figures as if they never train

steps.action: Tap a member
user_sees: Their Progress card
must_not: Another member's card

start: Other way in as trainer: a member's page reached from the Members list or search, not from 'My members'

steps.action: Open a member who is assigned to this trainer
user_sees: The Progress card
must_not: An empty card for an assigned, sharing member

steps.action: Open a member of another trainer
user_sees: No progress (the server answers 'not allowed'); exact words unknown: screen not read
must_not: The other trainer's member's workouts

start: As owner; a member who has the app but sharing is off, and a member who never opened the app

steps.action: Open the first member's Progress card
user_sees: Words that the member has not switched on 'Share my workouts with my trainers' in their app; no chart, no workouts
must_not: Any summary, recent workout or 'last updated' time for a member who does not share

steps.action: Open the second member
user_sees: No Progress figures; a plain line why
must_not: An endless spinner; an error

start: As trainer; a member who has the app but sharing is off, and a member who never opened the app

steps.action: Open the first member's Progress card
user_sees: Words that the member has not switched on 'Share my workouts with my trainers' in their app; no chart, no workouts
must_not: Any summary, recent workout or 'last updated' time for a member who does not share

steps.action: Open the second member
user_sees: No Progress figures; a plain line why
must_not: An endless spinner; an error

start: As owner; a member who was sharing, with the card open in the panel

steps.action: The member switches sharing off in the app; reload the member
user_sees: The chart, bests and workouts are gone; the not-sharing words show
must_not: The last shared figures still on screen after a reload; the member still in 'My members'

steps.action: The member switches it on again and trains
user_sees: The card comes back with the new workout
must_not: Old weeks lost; the same workout counted twice

start: As owner; what the gym may see of a member's training

steps.action: Open a sharing member's card
user_sees: Only what the summary carries: weekly kg, workout counts, best lifts, recent workouts
must_not: Body weight, body measurements, photos or notes the member did not choose to share

steps.action: Sign in as front-desk staff who is not a trainer and open the same member
user_sees: Whether the card shows is unknown (screen not read); the promise says a trainer sees only their own members
must_not: A trainer seeing feedback or complaints; a non-assigned trainer seeing the workouts
